meta.method: The table "Latest test results" (date, rating, E. coli and intestinal enterococci in cfu/100 ml) on the Sea Lanes Canary Wharf water-quality page, and the water temperature shown on its Swimming page at fetch time. Eden Dock is the enclosed part of Middle Dock, West India Docks; the operator says it is fed by groundwater and cut off from the Thames, tested fortnightly. These are the operator's figures, not an EA bathing-water classification: Eden Dock is not a designated bathing water.
